paragraphs:
Sabrina Suppa is an artist and designer specialising in digital modelling. 
Her practice considers the body as a form under continuous forced evolution, inhabiting architectures that appear organic yet are shaped by technical precision.

Grounded in photorealism, her work begins with the close observation of natural forms. 
Through technology, she pushes these references beyond their original logic, tracing their trajectory from realism into abstraction.

In 2025, she began extending her digital practice into 3D printing and physical fabrication, developing architectures that reshape the human silhouette through a posthuman lens. 
Influenced by her studies in classical piano and interior design, she translates rhythm, structure, and geometric abstraction into sculptural forms.

She has been working as a character and creature artist in international studios within the film and gaming industry such as DNEG, Framestore, MPC and Ninja Theory where she cultivated her fascination with anatomical studies and the expressive potential of the human body.
